title: Action eligibility: backend gates vs frontend mirrors (launch, run, stop, edit, resend)
answers: Where is eligibility to launch a broadcast/batch decided?
Which frontend checks mirror backend API gates?
How do I stop a broadcast?
body:
- Launch batch: backend `HogFlowViewSet.batch_jobs` POST requires status==active; job snapshots trigger's stored filters (caller filters ignored); agent sources need `_require_audience_confirm_token`; `HogFlowBatchJob` post_save calls CDP with `max_audience_size` from `get_hogflow_batch_trigger_limit`. Frontend: `HogFlowManualTriggerButton` disabled unless status==='active', no unsaved changes, blastRadius.affected<=limit; `broadcastWizardLogic.launchBroadcast` repeats limit check.
- Run now: `run` action requires active and trigger.type=="schedule", 5KB variable cap, Idempotency-Key (409 in progress).
- Edit broadcast: no backend rule; frontend `broadcastWizardLogic.isReadOnly` = status!=='draft'; `BroadcastScene` shows BroadcastSummary for non-draft.
- Stop: `cancel_batch_job` acts only on waiting|queued|active, conditional update so completion wins race, flips only when CDP sweep reports done; frontend `WorkflowBatchInvocations` STOPPABLE_STATUSES. No stop control in BroadcastSummary.
- Resend: no endpoint; `rerun` replays ClickHouse invocations, needs person:read+group:read+hog_flow:write. New send = new batch job.
- Enable/disable: `WorkflowSceneHeader` toggles draft↔active, disabled with unsaved changes. Archive/restore in `workflowsLogic` (archived / draft); `bulk_delete` only deletes archived.
- Publish/discard: `publishDisabledReason`/`discardDisabledReason` in workflowLogic.ts.
applies: Backend batch_jobs/run gates are real; edit/enable/archive gates are frontend-only.
